tooltip.ccwirelessperipherals.help: Right-click a wireless/ender modem or server to select it, then right-click peripherals to link/unlink. Sneak + right-click a linked peripheral to rename it to this linker's anvil name (or reset it if unnamed). Sneak + right-click air to clear.
message.ccwirelessperipherals.no_host: Right-click a wireless modem, ender modem or server first
message.ccwirelessperipherals.wrong_dime: The selected host is in another dimension
message.ccwirelessperipherals.host_unloa: The selected host is not loaded
message.ccwirelessperipherals.host_gone: The selected host no longer exists
message.ccwirelessperipherals.host_black: This host is not allowed to have wireless peripherals
message.ccwirelessperipherals.too_many: This host already has the maximum of %s links
message.ccwirelessperipherals.ambiguous_: That block is linked to several hosts; select one with the linker first
message.ccwirelessperipherals.name_chars: '%s' may only use letters, digits and _ : . - /
message.ccwirelessperipherals.name_suffi: '%s' can't end in _<number> or _w<number> (reserved for automatic names)
message.ccwirelessperipherals.name_taken: '%s' is already used by another link
command.ccwirelessperipherals.no_selecti: Hold a Peripheral Linker with a selected host, or give a position
command.ccwirelessperipherals.cleared: Removed all links of that host
